title: Paramount/WBD merger delayed for months as states' lawsuit moves toward trial
summary: Discovery today agreed to what the state Attorneys General and the WGA both sought from the court: the merger will be put on hold pending the outcome of the states’ and the WGA’s cases or until June 1, 2027, whichever comes first,”…
